gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-michroma: Expressive and commanding, Funnel Display draws every stroke as one uniform thread, with no hairlines anywhere. And Michroma gives each tall-bodied letter wide margins, so paragraphs drift along unhurried.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-miriam-libre: Funnel Display draws every letter in spaghetti-like, same-width strokes. Miriam Libre's wire-weight lines, tall cast-iron lowercase and generous s bends keep whole paragraphs moving at a sturdy, unhurried pace.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mochiy-pop-one: Spaghetti-like strokes of one width give Funnel Display a commanding, expressive line. Mochiy Pop One does the quieter job, hanging big-eyed lowercase letters steadily along the line like clothespins.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mochiy-pop-p-on: Spaghetti strokes, all one width, full of swagger. Funnel Display's wiry uniform lines meet Mochiy Pop P One's wide stretches of space between letters, and that tension is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mozilla-headlin: Expressive thread-of-ink lines define Funnel Display, with no swelling or tapering anywhere. Mozilla Headline fills in beside them with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, adding sturdier texture.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-mozilla-text: Funnel Display keeps its t crossbar and stem at one width, expressive and commanding. And Mozilla Text's tall-bodied lowercase and outward-flaring terminals give the pairing a confident, bold look.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-nata-sans: Expressive from the first stroke, Funnel Display draws spaghetti-like lines of uniform width. Nata Sans handles the text instead, with a large central band and wide-mouthed curves drawn with a technical pen's steadiness.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-nobile: Wiry and commanding up top, Funnel Display keeps its bowls full at the sides while Nobile keeps capitals close to its lowercase. Those open letter mouths let paragraphs glide along.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-nokora: Funnel Display is rounded rod in a single weight, expressive and commanding. Nokora lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through every line, with a wide-open s that never tightens.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-noto-kufi-arabi: Funnel Display runs a single stroke width through its whole alphabet. Noto Kufi Arabic brings a welcoming gap in the c, capitals barely above lowercase, so paragraphs move along with a modern, clean steadiness.
